Show a draft

Related commands:
  draft update
  draft send
  read

Output:
  Shows text you can read in your terminal.
  Use --json to get JSON for scripts and other programs.
  Use --plain to get text without color or formatting.
  Use --jq to filter the JSON output with a jq expression.
  Use --template to format the output with a Go template.

Usage:
  maildo draft read [id] [flags]

Examples:
maildo draft read 3c1f2a7
maildo draft read --id 3c1f2a7
maildo draft read --id 3c1f2a7 --account work --json
maildo draft read --id 3c1f2a7 --body-mode html
maildo draft read --id 3c1f2a7 --plain

Flags:
      --account stringArray   Account to use (default: the active account)
      --body-mode string      How to show the body: readable, text, html or raw (default "readable")
  -h, --help                  help for read
      --id string             Draft id, or the short id maildo printed

Global Flags:
      --config string     Path to the config file
      --dry-run           Preview changes without performing them
      --include-meta      Wrap the JSON output as {data, meta} with request details
      --jq string         Filter the JSON output with a jq expression
      --json              Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi           Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color          Disable color in human output
      --no-pager          Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt         Never block on an interactive prompt
      --plain             Print text without color or formatting
      --quiet             Suppress non-essential output
      --template string   Format the JSON output with a Go text/template
